Evie Chan is a classically trained ballet dancer from Portland, Oregon. On stage, Evie has performed soloist and featured corps roles in Tom Gold's Petrushka, John Clifford's Firebird, John Clifford's A Midsummer Night’s Dream, Marius Petipa's Paquita, Tom Gold's Carnival of the Animals, and John Clifford's The Enchanted Toyshop with The Portland Ballet, as well as children’s roles in professional productions of Christopher Stowell's The Sleeping Beauty, Septime Webre's Alice in Wonderland, and George Balanchine's The Nutcracker with Oregon Ballet Theatre.
